Student internship guide · Palwal, Haryana

MVN University: psychology internship guide

In short: Students at MVN University in Palwal, Haryana should match mandated practicum hours and documentation to a supervised mental-health setting that their department approves in writing; near Greater Noida, Mind Grace Neuropsychiatric Clinic is one east-of-NCR option worth asking about early.

A UGC and AICTE-approved university whose occupational-therapy programme intersects with rehabilitation psychology.

Programmes offered

  • B.A. Psychology – 3 years
  • M.A. Psychology – 2 years
  • Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (closely intersecting rehabilitation psychology)

Syllabus highlights

  • Core psychology, sociology, and guidance counselling
  • Competencies in behavioural sciences and rehabilitation techniques

Internship and practicum requirements

  • Supervised practical training required
  • Coordinated through university tie-ups with regional healthcare and educational bodies

Special features

  • UGC and AICTE approved
  • Occupational-therapy programme intersecting rehabilitation psychology

Where Mind Grace fits, east of NCR

Rehabilitation is where Mind Grace’s “neuropsychiatric” prefix earns its keep: functional recovery planning, family training, and school re-entry after illness. MVN’s OT-psychology blend finds a natural eastern anchor for exactly this kind of supervised exposure.

Questions about your university requirements

Check whether your department requires an internship letter, attendance record, case or project report, reflective notebook, supervisor evaluation, or a particular number of hours. A hospital or clinic name alone does not establish that a placement is available or that it satisfies your course.

Mind Grace as a starting option

Mind Grace Neuropsychiatric Clinic in Sector 128, Greater Noida West, can be a starting option for students who want to ask about supervised psychology learning opportunities east of the Yamuna — outpatient neurosis, neuropsychiatric rehabilitation, de-addiction, family counselling, and teleconsultation work. Read the Mind Grace internship enquiry guide and use the contact page to ask about current availability. Any opportunity, supervision, schedule, and documentation must be confirmed directly; students must not independently diagnose, interpret tests for patients, or provide therapy.

Frequently asked questions

Can occupational-therapy and psychology students both attach to Mind Grace?

Rehabilitation-flavoured attachments suit both, with different lenses: OT students focus on functional and daily-living goals, psychology students on assessment and counselling process. Scope, supervision, and permitted activities are set separately for each discipline in writing.

Does Mind Grace supervise student interns directly?

Clinical supervision and training opportunities are arranged on a case-by-case basis with the treating RCI-licensed clinical psychologist. Availability, duration, documentation formats, and the scope of permitted activities must always be confirmed in writing before you log any hours.

What can psychology interns realistically do at Mind Grace?

Interns typically observe assessments, assist with record keeping and psychoeducation under supervision, support intake workflows, and co-conduct research or awareness projects. Interns never independently diagnose, interpret test protocols for patients, or deliver therapy.

Will Mind Grace provide an internship completion letter?

Placements that run to completion generally receive an official letter describing your tenure, supervised activities, and conduct. Share your university template early so the letter satisfies your department’s exact requirements for hours, signatures, and letterhead.
